insights.title: VIP Early Access has the highest engagement
insights.description: Open rate: 58.7% — 13.3% above your average of 45.4%.
insights.recommendation: Use similar subject-line and content strategies for future campaigns targeting the same audience segments.

insights.title: Q1 Customer Survey drives the most clicks
insights.description: Click rate: 21.5% — well above the platform average of 8.5%.
insights.recommendation: Analyze the CTA placement and email copy — replicate this structure in upcoming promotional campaigns.

insights.title: Re-engagement Campaign underperformed
insights.description: Open rate of 31.7% is 13.7% below average. Subject line or send timing may need adjustment.
insights.recommendation: A/B test alternative subject lines and experiment with different send times for similar audience segments.
